# character-portrait (reference summary)

## Purpose
Plan a character-portrait scene (subject, pose, expression, wardrobe, framing, lighting, background) before any modeling or render attempt.

Translate a single-subject character-portrait intent (subject identity, pose, expression, wardrobe, framing, lighting, background) into a structured scene plan with an explicit assumptions register. Distinct from `product-hero-scene-planner` (manufactured products), `environment-shot` (places), and `interior-scene` (rooms). Multi-character ensembles are out of scope. Hands off framing deep-dives to `camera-composition`, lookdev deep-dives to `lighting-material-plan`, assets to `asset-discovery`, and validation to `composition-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, and `scene-readiness`.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/character-portrait/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/character-portrait/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `character-portrait-and-turntable-architect`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- intent is explicitly a character / person / creature portrait
- before any modeling or scene file is built
- when the consumer is editorial / brand / catalog / cinematic

## Trigger cues
- "portrait of"
- "character looking at the camera"
- "headshot"
- "hero shot of [person / mascot / creature]"

## When not to use
- product hero scenes → delegate to `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skills/product-hero-scene-planner.md`; use product-hero-scene-planner)
- environment establishing shots → delegate to `environment-shot` (`references/skills/environment-shot.md`; use environment-shot)
- interior arch viz → delegate to `interior-scene` (`references/skills/interior-scene.md`; use interior-scene)
- multi-character ensemble (this skill is single-subject) → delegate to `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; this skill is single-subject)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Locked 3D brief specifying character subject, expression/pose, and framing intent
- `character_asset_posture` (`object`): Available character model/rig status and material readiness from asset discovery

### Optional inputs
- `turntable_or_still_preference` (`string`): Whether the deliverable is a portrait still, bust turntable, or full-body pose

### Primary outputs
- `character_staging_and_pose_plan`
- `eyeline_and_portrait_camera_anchors`
- `skin_hair_rim_lighting_hooks`

## Quick-start procedure
1. confirm single-subject scope and upstream brief from `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`
2. confirm likeness rights before use if the subject is a real person
3. pin subject identity, pose, expression, wardrobe, framing, lighting, and background
4. record an explicit assumptions register
5. flag needed assets for `asset-discovery`
6. emit handoffs to `camera-composition`, `lighting-material-plan`, and quality checkers with `Runtime status: Not Run` and `Artifact status: Not Produced`

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Upstream brief → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`) — `when.all: [goal.clarity equals "clear"; brief.locked equals false]`
- **[progression]** Framing deep-dive → `camera-composition` (`references/skills/camera-composition.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "camera_planning"]`
- **[progression]** Lookdev deep-dive → `lighting-material-plan` (`references/skills/lighting-material-plan.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "lookdev_planning"]`

- **[progression]** Composition validation → `composition-quality-checker` (`references/skills/composition-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "composition"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[progression]** Lighting validation → `lighting-quality-checker` (`references/skills/lighting-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "lighting"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Planning-only skill: no modeling, no animation, no render, and no Blender execution. `Runtime status` stays `Not Run` and `Artifact status` stays `Not Produced` (downgrade-only, never upgrade). If the brief is unclear, hand off to `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`.
- Model the character.
- Animate the character.
- Render.
- Run Blender.
